# Sourdough Bread

A sourdough starter is a fermented mixture of flour and water that contains
wild yeast and lactic acid bacteria.

## Feeding the starter

Feed the starter daily with equal weights of flour and water. Discard half
before each feeding to keep the acidity in check.

## Baking

Bake the loaf in a preheated Dutch oven at 250°C for 20 minutes with the lid
on, then 25 minutes with the lid off until the crust is deep brown.
